repair.root_cause: SOME/IP inherits an Ethernet link rate in its declared stack but the parameter form only renders the top-level protocol rate model; automotive recommends the unregistered automotive_ethernet identity. Wizard questionnaire stage buttons are disabled for every status phase, including a stopped blocked/error run.
repair.first_failing_layer: Parameter schema generation / questionnaire navigation guard
repair.reproduction: DEFAULT_TECHNOLOGY_REGISTRY.validate_parameters("someip", {}) returns missing bitrate_bps inherited from ethernet; catalog has no automotive_ethernet profile; source disables questionnaire steps whenever phase=status.
acceptance_criteria: Automotive technology list includes the registered Ethernet technology.
SOME/IP parameter schema includes an inherited Ethernet link speed field and explicit value passes stack validation.
A stopped errored/blocked wizard run can return to prior questionnaire fields; active runs remain non-navigable.
